newsitem.title: USA: OLYMPIC CASCADE ACQUIRES TRAVIS CAPITAL.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPIC CASCADE ACQUIRES TRAVIS CAPITAL.

text.p: Olympic Cascade Financial Corp Thursday acquired Travis Capital Inc, a brokerage firm based in Salt Lake City.
Olympic Cascade acquired 100 percent of the stock of Travis Capital for common stock of Olympic Cascade, but the company did not disclose how many shares would be issued.
Travis Capital's primary focus is private placements for emerging and middle market companies in the U.S. and inte
Travis Capital will be operated as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Olympic Cascade.
